name: self-compact
description: Lets Claude compact its own context (a real /compact: the chat history stays visible), carry text verbatim across it and resume itself

alwaysInstructions.title: Always keep (summary instructions)
alwaysInstructions.description: Added to the summarizer's instructions on every self-compaction, and on a typed /compact or an auto-compaction of the main conversation where this plugin's compaction hook runs (see the README).

alwaysCarry.title: Always carry (verbatim after the summary)
alwaysCarry.description: Placed verbatim after the summary on every self-compaction (and on other compactions where this plugin's compaction hook runs), e.g. 'Re-read docs/HANDOFF.md before continuing.'

blockToolsAfterRequest.title: Refuse other tool calls after a request
blockToolsAfterRequest.description: While a requested compaction waits for the turn to end, refuse the main agent's other tool calls, so that the turn ends and the compaction runs before the context fills up. Off: the agent only gets a reminder beside each tool result.

allowAfterRequest.title: Tools still allowed after a request
allowAfterRequest.description: Tool names, separated by commas, that the main agent may still call while a compaction waits (a trailing * matches a prefix), e.g. 'SendMessage, mcp__notes__*'.

burstLimit.title: Most self-compactions per window
burstLimit.description: The request_compaction tool refuses a new request once this many self-compactions ran in the window below, in the same session. 0 = no limit.

burstWindowMinutes.title: Window for the limit above, in minutes
burstWindowMinutes.description: The time span the burst limit counts over.

minContextTokens.title: Smallest context worth compacting, in tokens
minContextTokens.description: The tool refuses a request while the context holds fewer tokens than this (where the host reports the size). 0 = no check.

minIntervalMinutes.title: Minimum minutes between self-compactions
minIntervalMinutes.description: The tool refuses a new request within this many minutes of the last self-compaction in the same session. 0 = off (the default since 0.4; it was 10 before).
